## Problem

What problem or limitation prompted this request? (Link to the
[Current limitations](../../README.md#current-limitations) or
[Roadmap](../../README.md#roadmap) section if this relates to something
already listed there.)

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see happen. If you have a specific approach in mind,
describe it — but it's fine to just describe the desired outcome.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you preferred this one.

## Additional context

Anything else relevant — e.g. whether this would require a Domain change,
touch the GitHub API surface, affect the API's public contract, etc.
